title: Pulse's top row: Your day wide, posting under + New, settings in a panel, sort arrows on every heading, Working as removed; the board's light off the Dashboard
why: Jason's notes of 2026-11-19 on Pulse: Your day ("bad design") opens wide over a dimmed page; posting is under + New ("best handled under the + for creating messages"), Quick actions keeps only its links; Stream settings has a sliders icon and opens in the drawer ("shouldnt send me to a new page"); every heading shows its sort arrow, faint until used ("visible by every column title"), with a funnel for the filters; a line sets the row's buttons apart ("they should have a separator"); "Working as" removed ("the original drop down items dont even apply now do they?" then "Remove it"); Group's label in the menu's words; and the System Control Board's light isn't on the Dashboard, where Pulse lists the trips ("is this really needed here on the pulse?" then "Hide it on Pulse"; decisions/0171 §7's note). app/ui/pulse-ui.php, website/admin/router.php, FAQ.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
